role: CI gate: every String(localized:) / NSLocalizedString( call in Emuqu/Sources must contain a `bundle:` argument within its parentheses.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail. SOURCE_ROOT=$1 or Emuqu/Sources (relative; no cd). Python masks string literals, finds calls, skips lines starting //, paren-matches the call and requires `bundle:` inside. Offenders -> exit 1. Else counts lookups with grep and prints clean. Watch target deliberately excluded. Wired: gates.yml, ci.yml, Makefile.

flags.text: README says every lookup must name LanguageManager.appBundle; the gate accepts any `bundle:` argument (e.g. bundle: .main).
